evals.name: mixed-work-and-home
evals.prompt: Help me prioritize: finish Jira ticket PAY-142 (checkout bug, customers can't pay), Jira ticket PAY-150 (refactor logging, no deadline), dust the house, go running.
evals.expected_output: Separate Work and Home/Health matrices. PAY-142 in Do, PAY-150 in Schedule (or Eliminate after a question), dusting and running in Schedule. No chore in Eliminate.
expectations: Areas: PAY-142 and PAY-150 are Work; dusting is Home; running is Health or Home
Prints more than one matrix, each under a heading naming its area (e.g. ### Work)
PAY-142 is in Do
PAY-150 is in Schedule, Eliminate, or asked about; not in Do
Dust the house is in Schedule, or asked about; never in Eliminate
Go running is in Schedule, or asked about; never in Eliminate
Does not justify a home or health task's quadrant by comparing it to the work tasks

evals.name: single-area
evals.prompt: Eisenhower matrix for my work tasks: prod database is down right now, write Q3 design doc for next quarter's roadmap, reply to the vendor survey that marketing forwarded.
evals.expected_output: One matrix with no area heading, in the same format as before areas existed.
expectations: Areas: all three tasks are Work
Prints exactly one 2x2 table and no area heading
Prod database down is in Do
Q3 design doc is in Schedule
Vendor survey is in Delegate or Eliminate, or asked about; not in Do

evals.name: clear-cut-tasks
evals.prompt: Prioritize these: prod is down and customers are affected, file my taxes which are due tomorrow.
evals.expected_output: Both tasks placed in Do with no interview questions.
expectations: Areas: prod is Work; taxes is Home, Personal, Finance or similar
Prod is down is in Do
File taxes is in Do
Asks no urgency or importance question about either task

evals.name: due-date-is-not-urgency
evals.prompt: Help me prioritize: update the team wiki page, it takes about an hour and is due next month.
evals.expected_output: The task is not in Do; Schedule (or a question) is expected.
expectations: Areas: wiki page is Work
The wiki task is not in Do
If placed, it is in Schedule and the agent asks for a date

evals.name: unclear-area
evals.prompt: What should I work on first? Fix the failing CI build blocking the release today, call Sam, buy groceries.
evals.expected_output: One batched round of questions that includes the area of 'call Sam'; no separate round just for the area.
expectations: Areas: CI build is Work; groceries is Home; call Sam is asked about or guessed
Fix CI build is in Do with no question about it
Buy groceries is not in Eliminate
Any question about the area of 'call Sam' is in the same turn as the other interview questions, not a separate round

evals.name: later-turn-edits
evals.prompt:
Here is my matrix from earlier:

### Work

| | **Urgent** | **Not urgent** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Important** | **Do:** Fix login bug | **Schedule:** Write report (Fri 14 Nov) |
| **Not important** | **Delegate:** Book venue → Sam | **Eliminate:** — |

### Home

| | **Urgent** | **Not urgent** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Important** | **Do:** — | **Schedule:** Clean gutters (Sat 15 Nov) · Plan vacation (1 Dec) |
| **Not important** | **Delegate:** — | **Eliminate:** — |

Updates: I finished the login bug. Remove book venue. Move clean gutters to Do. Plan vacation is actually a work offsite, move it to Work. Add: renew passport, it expires in 3 weeks and I fly in 4.
evals.expected_output: Login bug on the Done line, venue gone, gutters in Home Do, offsite under Work in Schedule, passport added under a non-work area (likely Do), full matrices reprinted.
expectations: Areas: plan vacation/offsite is now under Work; renew passport is Home, Personal or Travel
Fix login bug is on a Done: line below the last table and not in any quadrant
Book venue is gone from every table
Clean gutters is in Do in the Home table
Plan vacation/offsite is under Work and keeps Schedule (1 Dec)
Renew passport is in Do, or asked about once
Write report keeps Schedule (Fri 14 Nov) and is not re-asked about
All remaining tables are reprinted in full

evals.name: re-interview
evals.prompt:
Here is my matrix:

| | **Urgent** | **Not urgent** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Important** | **Do:** — | **Schedule:** Write report (Fri 14 Nov) · Update resume (1 Dec) |
| **Not important** | **Delegate:** — | **Eliminate:** — |

My situation changed for update resume, can you re-interview it?
evals.expected_output: Questions about update resume only; write report untouched.
expectations: Areas: both tasks stay in one area, so one table with no heading
Asks at least one urgency or importance question about update resume
Asks nothing about write report

evals.name: formatting
evals.prompt: Help me prioritize: investigate and fix the intermittent timeout errors in the payments service that started after last Tuesday's deploy and are hitting about 2% of checkout requests. That's it for now.
evals.expected_output: One table, short task name, empty quadrants shown as —, no HTML.
expectations: Areas: payments timeouts is Work
The task name in the table is shortened to a few words
Every empty quadrant reads '<Quadrant>:** —' (an em dash after the name)
Each table cell is on one line and contains no HTML such as
No Done: line is printed, since nothing is complete
